title: The Fence at Piazza della Civetta
synopsis: A tall fence stands around the owl square.
Behind it, a building site, a yellow helmet and a locked office.
In two days, the concrete comes.
goal: Find out whose site this is, what came here on Thursday night, and tell Sofia why the work must stop.

notes: Letter: the work plan on the fence, its dates out of order (1, 2, 3 and 10 May).

clueInputs.note: The city plan: concrete on 10 May, 7 AM.
The owl square is Piazza della Civetta.

learning.objective: 날짜(1 May, 2 May, 3 May, 10 May)를 비교해 공사 계획을 순서대로 놓는다.
expressions: On 1 May, they put up the fence.
On 10 May, they will pour the concrete.

play.title: The Work Plan
story: Today is 8 May. Piazza della Civetta is hidden behind a tall fence.
Above the gate is a sign with a little crane on it.
A work plan is pinned to the fence.
play.letter:
VALLI BUILDING — WORK PLAN
10 May, 7 AM — Pour the concrete.
1 May — Put up the fence.
3 May — Dig the big hole.
2 May — Close the square to people.
play.question: Put the work plan in order, from the first day to the last.
hints: Look only at the dates. Which number is the smallest?
transition: Fence, close the square, dig, pour the concrete.
Today is 8 May. The concrete comes in two days.
Through a gap in the fence, Livia points. "Look! A yellow helmet!"
play.orderFeedback: Read the dates again. Start with the smallest number.

clue.title: The Work Plan
clue.note: Valli Building will pour concrete over the square on 10 May. Today is 8 May.

evidence.name: Valli's Work Plan
evidence.description: The work plan pinned to the building site's fence.

play.evidenceLinkLine: The city plan in Aldo's cabinet said the same: concrete on 10 May at 7 AM.

notes: Recall: Bruno's business card (Case 07), the same little crane. Letter: the helmet's name strip, torn into VAL and LI.

clueInputs.note: Bruno's card has the same crane as the helmet.
Pia saw a yellow helmet with a crane on Thursday night.

learning.objective: 찢어진 이름표 두 조각(VAL, LI)을 맞추고 명함과 비교해 주인의 성을 쓴다.
expressions: The name strip is torn in two.

play.title: The Yellow Helmet
story: A yellow helmet hangs on a hook by the fence.
It has a little crane on the front, just like Pia said.
Inside the helmet is a name strip, torn in two.
play.letter:
Left piece: B. VAL
Right piece: LI

The helmet's little crane looks like the crane on a card in your Notebook.
play.question: Put the torn name back together. Spell the family name.
hints: Look at the business card with the same crane on it.
transition: B. VALLI. Bruno Valli, the show's sponsor.
The big man Pia saw on Thursday night wore this helmet.
A young worker sees you at the fence. He looks around, then comes closer.
play.orderFeedback: Those are the right letters. Put the left piece first.

clue.title: The Helmet's Owner
clue.note: The yellow crane helmet is Bruno Valli's. Pia saw it on Thursday night.

evidence.name: The Yellow Helmet
evidence.description: A yellow helmet with a little crane, on a hook at the site.

recall.title: The same crane
recall.prompt: Which thing in your Notebook has the same little crane?
recall.miss: Look for a card with a crane on it.

options.label: Bricks for the car park
options.feedback: Bricks came on Wednesday morning, in the open. Why would bricks be a secret?

options.label: The plaster copy
options.feedback: The copy was in the museum until Friday at midnight. You found it at the bookshop.

notes: Letter: the worker's words and the site's gate log. Thursday 11:50 PM is twenty minutes after Pia saw the heavy box, the night of the swap.

clueInputs.note: Pia: Thursday, 11:30 PM, a heavy box from the museum road.
The swap was on Thursday night.

learning.objective: 출입 기록의 시각을 이전 단서(목요일 밤 11:30, 바꿔치기)와 이어 상자 속 물건을 추론한다.

play.title: The Box Nobody May Open
story: "I am new here," the worker whispers. "Something is strange."
He shows you the gate log, and tells you about his boss.
play.letterIntro: The worker and the gate log say:
play.letter:
THE WORKER:
"The boss keeps a heavy box in his office. Nobody may open it."

THE SITE GATE LOG:
WEDNESDAY, 8:00 AM — Bricks, 200.
THURSDAY, 11:50 PM — B. Valli. One heavy box.
FRIDAY, 7:30 AM — Sand, 3 bags.
play.question: What is most likely in Signor Valli's heavy box?
hints: Pia saw the big man with a heavy box on Thursday at 11:30 PM.
What was taken from the museum on Thursday night?
transition: At 11:30 PM, Pia saw the heavy box. At 11:50 PM, it came through this gate.
The real piece came here on the night of the swap!
Livia's hands shake. "We must tell Sofia. Now."

clue.title: Thursday, 11:50 PM
clue.note: On Thursday at 11:50 PM, Valli brought a heavy box to the site. Nobody may open it.

evidence.name: The Site Gate Log
evidence.description: The log of everything that came through the site gate.
evidence.inscription: THURSDAY, 11:50 PM — B. Valli. One heavy box.

notes: Letter: Sofia's message asking what is under the square, and your notes (BIBLIOTHECA).

clueInputs.note: The real piece is likely in Valli's office.

learning.objective: 지금까지의 단서로 Sofia의 질문(무엇이 광장 아래에 있나)에 영어 단어로 답한다.
expressions: Under the square, there is an old Roman library.

play.title: A Message for Sofia
story: Giulia calls Director Sofia. Then Sofia sends a message.
She needs one word to make the city listen.
play.letterIntro: Sofia's message and your notes say:
play.letter:
SOFIA:
"I can bring the city inspector tomorrow.
But I must tell him why the work must stop.
What is under the square?"

YOUR NOTES:
The real piece shows a room under the owl square.
The room's Latin name is BIBLIOTHECA.
play.question: Answer Sofia. What is under the square?
play.prompt: Under the square, there is an old Roman ____.
hints: Look at Aldo's Latin card in your Notebook.
The room is a room for books.
transition: Sofia writes back at once: "I am coming with the inspector!"
"But we need proof. Without the real piece, Signor Valli will say there is nothing down there."
In the site office, behind the fence, a light is still on.

feedback.BATH: A bath is BALNEUM in Latin. Look at your notes again.
feedback.THEATRE: A theatre is THEATRUM in Latin. Look at your notes again.

play.orderFeedback: Check your spelling on Aldo's Latin card.

evidence.name: Your Message to Sofia
evidence.description: Your message to Director Sofia about the square.
evidence.inscription: Under the square, there is an old Roman library.

hook: Is the real piece in Valli's office? Tomorrow, the inspector will come.

learningGoal.title: Dates and proof: 1 May to 10 May, nobody may
learningGoal.titleKo: 날짜와 증거: 1 May–10 May, nobody may

objectives: Read the work plan on the fence.
Find out what came on Thursday night.
intro: Piazza della Civetta is a small, quiet square.
Or it was. Now there is a tall fence all around it.
"Two more days," Livia says. "Then the concrete comes."
play.caseSummary: The work plan says concrete on 10 May. The yellow crane helmet is B. Valli's. On Thursday at 11:50 PM, Valli brought a heavy box to the site: the real piece. You told Sofia an old Roman library is under the square.

notes: Bruno is not met here: his helmet, his gate log and his work plan speak for him. He is revealed face to face in Case 11.
The worker is unnamed on purpose (not a season character).
